description:
Get iMessage line contact profile

Reads the dedicated line's confirmed contact-profile configuration. Pending changes are not exposed. Project mode resolves the Projects agent identity; custom mode returns the line's own names and pictureUrl; none resolves to null. Requires platforms:read bound to the path project.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/imessage/get-imessage-line-contact-profile
name: getImessageLineContactProfile

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: Known values: ["project","custom","none"]. Others may be added.
